nodes.description: Public totalSupply of the token, set once in the RaiseYourBet constructor to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Global transfer switch; when false every transfer/transferFrom reverts. Toggled by the owner.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances; written before external callbacks in ERC223 transfers.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances used by transferFrom/approve/allowance.
Privileged owner address; guards onlyOwner functions changeOwner and enableTransfers.
Constant 75e7 * 10**18 supply minted to the owner in the constructor.
ERC223Token.transfer(address,uint256,bytes) - ERC223 transfer that probes extcodesize and calls tokenFallback on contract recipients.
ERC223Token.transfer(address,uint256) - ERC20-compatible transfer that still performs the ERC223 tokenFallback callback with empty data.
balanceOf(address) constant view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) - allowance-based transfer, protected only by onlyPayloadSize(3).
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256) - overwrites the caller's allowance for a spender (classic approve race).
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) view of remaining allowance.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint256) - increments the caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint256) - decrements or zeroes the caller's allowance.
RaiseYourBet.changeOwner(address) - onlyOwner ownership transfer, no renounce/zero-owner guard beyond require(_newOwner != 0).
RaiseYourBet.enableTransfers(bool) - onlyOwner switch for the global transfer flag.
RaiseYourBet constructor(address) - mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to _owner, sets owner and enables transfers.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
SafeMath.add - overflow-checked addition used for balance/allowance increases.
SafeMath.sub - underflow-checked subtraction used for balance/allowance decreases.
SafeMath.mul - overflow-checked multiplication (unused by the token logic).
SafeMath.div - division helper (unused by the token logic).
External call receiver.tokenFallback(msg.sender,_value,_data) performed AFTER balance updates but WITHOUT a reentrancy guard on an attacker-controlled recipient.
External call receiver.tokenFallback(msg.sender,_value,empty) in the data-less transfer overload; same unguarded reentrancy surface.
msg.sender - untrusted caller used as balance holder, spender of allowances and owner check subject.
Parameter _to of transfer(address,uint256,bytes): attacker-controlled recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(address,uint256,bytes): amount to move.
Parameter _data of transfer(address,uint256,bytes): arbitrary calldata forwarded to the recipient callback.
Local codeLength in transfer(address,uint256,bytes), filled by inline assembly extcodesize(_to); gates the callback.
Local receiver in transfer(address,uint256,bytes): ERC223ReceivingContract cast of the attacker-supplied _to.
Parameter _to of transfer(address,uint256): recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(address,uint256): amount to move.
Local codeLength in transfer(address,uint256), set by extcodesize(_to).
Local empty bytes passed as _data to tokenFallback in the two-argument transfer.
Local receiver in transfer(address,uint256): ERC223ReceivingContract cast of _to.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: address whose balance is debited.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount moved and deducted from allowance.
Parameter _spender of approve: address granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of approve: allowance amount written unconditionally.
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval, added with SafeMath.add.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval.
Local oldValue in decreaseApproval holding the current allowance before decrement/zeroing.
Parameter _owner of allowance().
Parameter _spender of allowance().
Parameter _newOwner of changeOwner: arbitrary address becomes owner.
Parameter _transfersEnabled of enableTransfers: new value of the global switch.
Constructor parameter _owner receiving the whole INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf: address whose balance is read.

edges.reason: _to is validated against address(0) and used to build the recipient callback target.
_value is checked against balances[msg.sender] and moved.
_data is forwarded verbatim to the recipient ERC223 callback.
codeLength (extcodesize of _to) decides whether the callback branch is taken.
codeLength>0 is the only gate before invoking the external tokenFallback call.
receiver is cast from the caller-supplied _to and its tokenFallback is invoked.
receiver = ERC223ReceivingContract(_to) derives the call target from _to.
Attacker-controlled _data reaches the external callee, which may re-enter the token.
transfer(address,uint256,bytes) performs an unguarded external call to a contract recipient.
balances are updated immediately before the external callback, so reentrant calls observe mutated state.
The reentered callee can call transfer again and further mutate the balances mapping.
msg.sender is passed as _from to the external tokenFallback, exposing the caller identity to the callee.
_to determines the recipient and the extcodesize probe.
_value is the amount transferred and balance-checked.
codeLength local holds the extcodesize result of _to.
empty bytes is used both as callback data and in the Transfer event.
receiver is cast from the attacker-supplied _to and invoked without a reentrancy guard.
receiver = ERC223ReceivingContract(_to).
The ERC20-compatible transfer still performs the ERC223 external callback.
Balances are written before the callback, allowing reentrant state reuse.
codeLength>0 gates entry into the external call branch.
The empty bytes payload is forwarded to the external callee.
msg.sender is the account debited in balances[msg.sender] and the _from reported to the receiver.
msg.sender is the debited account and the reported sender of the ERC223 event/callback.
_from selects the balance and allowance entries touched by transferFrom.
_to is the credited destination address.
_value is the amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] and added to balances[_to].
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is read as a precondition and then reduced.
_value is deducted from allowed[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender identifies which spender's allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
_spender keys the allowance entry that approve overwrites.
_value is written directly into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] without an intermediate-zero requirement.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
_value is stored in allowed[msg.sender][_spender], enabling the classic approve front-running race.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
_spender keys the allowance entry incremented by increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the existing allowance via SafeMath.add.
increaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is the allowance owner being increased.
_spender keys the allowance entry modified by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is compared with oldValue to decide zeroing vs SafeMath.sub.
oldValue caches allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before modification.
decreaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
oldValue is derived from allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender is the allowance owner being decreased.
_owner selects the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance().
_spender selects the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance().
allowance() reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
_owner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before changeOwner executes.
_newOwner is the caller-supplied address that becomes the new privileged owner.
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable, transferring all onlyOwner privileges.
onlyOwner restricts enableTransfers to the current owner.
_transfersEnabled is the new value written to the global switch.
enableTransfers writes transfersEnabled, which gates every transfer path.
transfer(address,uint256,bytes) requires transfersEnabled to be true.
transfer(address,uint256) requires transfersEnabled to be true.
transferFrom requires transfersEnabled to be true.
The constructor takes an arbitrary _owner argument that receives full supply and privileges.
Constructor assigns owner = _owner, granting onlyOwner rights to a supplied address.
Constructor sets totalSupply = INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor uses INITIAL_SUPPLY as the mint amount.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor sets transfersEnabled = true.
SafeMath.add guards the balance increments in transfer/transferFrom.
SafeMath.sub guards the balance and allowance decrements against underflow.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient input of transfer(address,uint256,bytes); fold it into that function node.
_value is the moved amount of transfer(address,uint256,bytes); fold it into that function node.
_data is the calldata payload of transfer(address,uint256,bytes); fold it into that function node.
codeLength exists only to gate the extcodesize-based external tokenFallback call of the data-carrying transfer.
receiver is the cast target of the unsafe external tokenFallback invocation.
_to is the recipient input of the two-argument transfer; fold into that function node.
_value is the transferred amount of the two-argument transfer; fold into that function node.
codeLength gates the external callback branch of the data-less transfer.
empty bytes is the payload actually forwarded to the external tokenFallback callee.
receiver is the ERC223ReceivingContract cast used for the unsafe external call.
_from is the debited account parameter of transferFrom.
_to is the credited account parameter of transferFrom.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance value written by approve.
_spender keys the allowance incremented by increaseApproval.
_addedValue is the delta added by increaseApproval.
_spender keys the allowance decreased by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is the delta applied by decreaseApproval.
oldValue is a transient cache of the allowance inside decreaseApproval.
_owner is the outer mapping key of the allowance view function.
_spender is the inner mapping key of the allowance view function.
_newOwner is the privileged address assigned by changeOwner; fold into that function node.
_transfersEnabled is the only input written to the global switch by enableTransfers.
_owner is the constructor argument that receives supply and ownership; fold into the constructor node.
_owner is the mapping lookup key used by the balanceOf view.
